LESSON: ATTRIBUTES OF GOD

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.6: Attributes of God

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Attributes of God. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should you know the attributes of God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read scriptures on the attributes of God,
2. list three attributes of God and revere Him,
3. recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names. The learner is guided to: Genesis 1:1-25 and 1Samuel 2:2 in turns, (Sole Creator, Loving Father, Holy Father), from a puzzle (sole creator, loving, holy), Father,’ Why should you know the attributes of God?

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. read scriptures on the attributes of God,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to read scriptures on the attributes of God,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. list three attributes of God and revere Him,
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to list three attributes of God and revere Him,. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names. The learner is guided to: Genesis 1:1-25 and 1Samuel 2:2 in turns, (Sole Creator, Loving Father, Holy Father), from a puzzle (sole creator, loving, holy), Father,’ Why should you know the attributes of God?
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names. The learner is guided to: Genesis 1:1-25 and 1Samuel 2:2 in turns, (Sole Creator, Loving Father, Holy Father), from a puzzle (sole creator, loving, holy), Father,’ Why should you know the attributes of God?. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Attributes of God.
2. Explain Attributes of God to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: in groups, picture-read 1 John 4:7-8, Genesis 1:1-25 and 1Samuel 2:2 in turns,
4. Show that you can: read scriptures on the attributes of God,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Attributes of God. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why should you know the attributes of God?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In groups, picture-read 1 John 4:7-8, Genesis 1:1-25 and 1Samuel 2:2 in turns,
2. Sing a song about the love of God.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. read scriptures on the attributes of God,
2. list three attributes of God and revere Him,
3. recognise God as a loving Father who knows them by their names. The learner is guided to: Genesis 1:1-25 and 1Samuel 2:2 in turns, (Sole Creator, Loving Father, Holy Father), from a puzzle (sole creator, loving, holy), Father,’ Why should you know the attributes of God?

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
